UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private profile for an authenticated user including ECDH public key and linked couple reference.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

publicKey.description: Base64 X.509 ECDH P-256 public key for end-to-end encryption.

shareDeviceStatus.description: Whether battery, network, and lock state are shared with partner.

partnerNickname.description: Optional custom affectionate nickname given to partner (max 40 chars).

isBanned.description: Admin-managed flag blocking account access immediately.

banReason.description: Optional admin reason displayed on suspension screen.

bannedAt.description: Server timestamp when account was banned.

PairCode.title: PairCode
PairCode.description: Six-digit single-use invite code linking two partners into a private CoupleSpace.

code.description: 6-digit numeric invite code matching document ID.

creatorUid.description: UID of partner who created the invite code.

creatorName.description: Display name of the inviting partner.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the invite code.

claimedByUid.description: UID of partner who claimed the code.

CoupleSpace.title: CoupleSpace
CoupleSpace.description: Shared private sanctuary for two partners with E2EE keys, special dates, and love pulse count.

creatorUid.description: UID of partner who created the couple space.

partnerUid.description: UID of second partner once joined.

memberUids.description: Bounded array of 1 to 2 partner UIDs.

inviteCode.description: Active 6-digit invite code (rotated upon dissolution so old code is invalidated).

status.description: Lifecycle state of the couple space.

dissolvedByUid.description: UID of partner who removed the link and reset the couple space.

dissolvedByName.description: Display name of partner who dissolved the couple space.

dissolvedAt.description: Server timestamp when the couple space was dissolved.

creatorPublicKey.description: Creator ECDH P-256 Base64 public key.

partnerPublicKey.description: Partner ECDH P-256 Base64 public key.

wrappedVaultKey.description: AES-256 vault key wrapped with invite-code derived key for pre-pairing handoff.

lastPulseByUid.description: UID of partner who sent the latest pulse.

lastPulseAt.description: Server timestamp of latest love pulse.

PartnerPresence.title: PartnerPresence
PartnerPresence.description: Real-time partner mood and device telemetry (battery percentage, charging, network type, lock/in-use status).

batteryPercent.description: Battery percentage 0-100, or -1 if sharing disabled.

charging.description: Whether the device is currently charging.

deviceStatus.description: Whether phone is in use or locked.

activeAppName.description: Friendly display name of the currently open foreground app (e.g., Duet, Instagram, WhatsApp).

deviceName.description: Friendly logged-in device name (manufacturer and model).

deviceSpecsJson.description: JSON string containing complete A-to-Z device specifications (OS, security patch, build, kernel, baseband, hardware, RAM, storage, display, carrier, app version).

statusShared.description: Whether device telemetry sharing is enabled.

typingActive.description: Whether the partner is currently typing in private chat.

typingUpdatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest typing status update.

lastSeenAt.description: Server timestamp when user was last active in Duet (for WhatsApp-style Last Seen).

EncryptedMessage.title: EncryptedMessage
EncryptedMessage.description: End-to-end encrypted direct message or photo shared privately between two partners.

ciphertext.description: Base64 AES-256-GCM ciphertext of message payload.

reactions.description: Per-partner emoji reaction map keyed by userId (max 2 entries).

seenByUid.description: Optional UID of partner who read the message.

seenAt.description: Optional server timestamp when partner read the message.

MoodEntry.title: MoodEntry
MoodEntry.description: Timestamped shared mood check-in logged by either partner.

comfortSentByUid.description: UID of partner who sent a comfort hug.

SharedMoment.title: SharedMoment
SharedMoment.description: End-to-end encrypted keepsake photo uploaded for your partner.

ciphertext.description: Base64 AES-256-GCM ciphertext of photo & caption payload.

lovedByUids.description: Bounded list (0-2) of partner UIDs who loved this moment.

SpecialDateEvent.title: SpecialDateEvent
SpecialDateEvent.description: Shared anniversary, birthday, or romantic milestone countdown.

creatorUid.description: UID of partner who added the event.

DailyPromptEntry.title: DailyPromptEntry
DailyPromptEntry.description: Daily intimate question answered by both partners and unlocked together.

dateKey.description: YYYY-MM-DD calendar key matching document ID.

promptIndex.description: Index into the curated couple prompt deck.

BucketListItem.title: BucketListItem
BucketListItem.description: Shared romantic bucket-list dream or couple goal checked off together.

creatorUid.description: UID of partner who added the dream.

creatorName.description: Display name of partner who added the dream.

title.description: Bucket-list dream or goal description (1-120 chars).

completed.description: Whether the couple has completed this dream together.

completedByUid.description: Optional UID of partner who marked it completed.

LoveLetter.title: LoveLetter
LoveLetter.description: Heartfelt sealed love letter or future time-capsule letter shared between partners.

LoveJarNote.title: LoveJarNote
LoveJarNote.description: Sweet appreciation note, compliment, memory, or secret wish placed inside the shared Love Jar.

VibeDedication.title: VibeDedication
VibeDedication.description: Song and musical vibe dedication sent to your partner with a personal note.

CareCheckIn.title: CareCheckIn
CareCheckIn.description: Gentle wellness and care check-in nudge sent between partners with quick acknowledgement.

LoveDoodle.title: LoveDoodle
LoveDoodle.description: Hand-drawn HD love sketch sent from the in-app drawing canvas to the shared couple gallery.

CouplePromise.title: CouplePromise
CouplePromise.description: Shared pinky-swear couple promise co-signed by both partners.

LiveAppConfig.title: LiveAppConfig
LiveAppConfig.description: Bondly Admin (com.aistudio.bondlyadmin.vzrqnp) real-time Over-The-Air configuration controlling maintenance mode, announcements, promo banners, feature flags, version control, and dynamic key-value config.

maintenanceMode.description: When true, hides main app screens behind Maintenance screen.

maintenanceTitle.description: Optional custom headline on the Maintenance screen.

maintenanceMessage.description: Admin message displayed while app is under maintenance.

maintenanceEta.description: Optional estimated completion time displayed on Maintenance screen.

upcomingMaintenance.description: When true, displays a top warning banner for scheduled maintenance.

upcomingMaintenanceText.description: Advance notice message for upcoming maintenance.

showBanner.description: When true, displays top announcement banner.

bannerTitle.description: Optional short title on the announcement banner.

bannerLink.description: Optional HTTPS URL opened when user taps the announcement banner.

bannerType.description: Visual severity style of the announcement banner.

showPromoBanner.description: When true, displays top promotional campaign banner.

promoTitle.description: Short headline for the promo banner.

promoText.description: Promotional body copy or offer summary.

promoBadge.description: Optional badge or promo code shown in pill.

promoCtaText.description: Optional call-to-action button label on promo banner.

promoLink.description: Optional HTTPS URL opened by promo banner CTA.

promoColor.description: Optional accent style key for promo banner.

sharedJournalEnabled.description: Feature flag controlling Shared Moments, Love Letters & Love Jar.

datePlannerEnabled.description: Feature flag controlling Date Planner countdowns & Date Wheel.

moodSyncEnabled.description: Feature flag controlling live Mood Sync card & history.

dailyPromptEnabled.description: Feature flag controlling Daily Prompt Check (Today's Question for Two).

forceUpdate.description: When true and app version is below minVersion, blocks app until updated.

showUpdateBanner.description: When true, shows top banner notifying user of an available app update.

showUpdatePopup.description: When true, shows optional update available popup dialog.

minVersion.description: Minimum required app version string or numeric code.

latestVersion.description: Latest released version advertised by Bondly Admin.

minVersionCode.description: Optional minimum required Android versionCode integer.

latestVersionCode.description: Optional latest released Android versionCode integer.

blockedVersions.description: List of blocked version names or version codes requiring immediate update.

updateTitle.description: Optional custom title on update banner/popup.

updateMessage.description: Release notes or changelog shown in the update popup and notification.

updateLink.description: Optional HTTPS URL where user can download the update.

dynamicConfig.description: Dynamic key-value parameters pushed in real time from Bondly Admin.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest admin update.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Server/Console-managed registry of authorized Bondly Admin operator UIDs.

/app_config/{configId}.description: Live OTA app configuration documents managed by Bondly Admin and read in real time by Bondly Couple Space.

/feature_flags/{flagId}.description: Live OTA feature flag toggles (sharedJournal, datePlanner, moodSync, dailyPromptCheck) managed by Bondly Admin.

/banners/{bannerId}.description: Live OTA announcement banners managed by Bondly Admin.

/promo_banners/{promoId}.description: Live OTA promotional banners managed by Bondly Admin.

/version_control/{versionId}.description: Live OTA version control rules (minVersion, latestVersion, forceUpdate, blockedVersions) managed by Bondly Admin.

/dynamic_config/{entryId}.description: Live OTA dynamic key-value parameters managed by Bondly Admin.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user profiles storing display name, ECDH public key, birthday, coupleId, and admin ban status.

/pair_codes/{code}.description: Six-digit invite code documents allowing exact lookup by code without list access.

/couples/{coupleId}.description: Couple space documents holding partner metadata, E2EE public keys, countdown dates, and pulse counter.

/couples/{coupleId}/presence/{memberUid}.description: Live partner device telemetry (battery, network, lock/in-use status) and active mood.

/couples/{coupleId}/messages/{messageId}.description: End-to-end encrypted direct messages and HD DM photos between the paired partners.

/couples/{coupleId}/moods/{moodId}.description: Shared mood tracker timeline entries logged by both partners.

/couples/{coupleId}/moments/{momentId}.description: End-to-end encrypted HD photo keepsakes uploaded for partner.

/couples/{coupleId}/events/{eventId}.description: Custom special dates and milestone countdowns shared by the couple.

/couples/{coupleId}/daily_prompts/{dateK.description: Daily couple questions answered by both partners and unlocked together.

/couples/{coupleId}/bucket_items/{itemId.description: Shared romantic bucket-list dreams and couple wishlist items synced between both partners.

/couples/{coupleId}/love_letters/{letter.description: Sealed love letters and future time-capsule notes exchanged between partners.

/couples/{coupleId}/love_jar/{noteId}.description: Shared Love Jar appreciation notes, compliments, memories, and wishes.

/couples/{coupleId}/vibe_dedications/{vi.description: Shared song and vibe dedications between partners.

/couples/{coupleId}/care_checkins/{check.description: Partner care and wellness check-in nudges with quick completion acknowledgements.

/couples/{coupleId}/love_doodles/{doodle.description: Hand-drawn HD love doodles shared in the couple sketch gallery.

/couples/{coupleId}/couple_promises/{pro.description: Co-signed pinky-swear couple promises and commitments.
